scope: SuiteOne-linked DCR2/Liberty Word export producer structure; static inspection only, no installer/app execution or vendor import.
method: 7-Zip static MSI/CAB/CHM extraction, existing ILSpy9.1 read-only managed-code decompilation; no program installation, activation, Word or recording execution.

producer.classic_horizontal_vertical: ProcessFileH/ProcessFileV replace the Word bookmark control CLSID:A0418111-CD85-4969-8385-297EC9EBB3A8 with INPUT TYPE BUTTON, NAME and VALUE caption, OnClick StartMeUp(native marker index). The content filename is selected stem + _content.HTML.
producer.caption: LoadButtonsBM limits the source name to50characters (47+ellipsis); replaces ampersand, apostrophe, doublequote and anglebrackets with periods. FormatCaption optionally appends a FILETIME-derived hh:mm:sstt and MM/dd/yyyy; this is clock time, not recording offset.
producer.indices: LoadButtonsBM adds Start position, sorts by native FILETIME, assigns in-range markers one-based indices. Before/after markers use special indices100001/100002 in classic content.
producer.positions: DCRTimes.Pos is obtained via player.GetPosFromTime. WriteWMPResourceToFileV and Mac-capable H write [caption,index,position] tuples into a companion player document. Classic Windows H uses native WMP marker indices. The content INPUT itself carries index, not playback seconds.
producer.modern_html5: ProcessFile34 emits a single main document with ChgPlayPos(position formatted invariant F1); before/after sentinels -1/-2. It is a different output from the classic _content.HTML required by SuiteOne guide.
producer.encoding: WriteBufferToFile uses Encoding.Default, with locale-dependent implications; no universal UTF8 claim for native producer files.
